mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(ID) FROM TESTS WHERE DEL_YN = 'N' AND SUBJECT_ID = #{subjectId}

SELECT ID , SUBJECT_ID , QUESTION , ANSWER_TYPE , ANSWER_SHEET_1 , ANSWER_SHEET_2 , ANSWER_SHEET_3 , ANSWER_SHEET_4 , ANSWER_SHEET_5 , ANSWER_COUNT , POINT_ALLOC , CRT_DT , MDFY_DT , CRTR_ID , MDFYR_ID , CORRECT_ANSWER , SUB_QUESTION FROM TESTS WHERE SUBJECT_ID = #{subjectId} AND DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY CRT_DT DESC, ID DESC

SELECT T.ID , T.SUBJECT_ID , T.QUESTION , T.ANSWER_TYPE , T.ANSWER_SHEET_1 , T.ANSWER_SHEET_2 , T.ANSWER_SHEET_3 , T.ANSWER_SHEET_4 , T.ANSWER_SHEET_5 , T.ANSWER_COUNT , T.POINT_ALLOC , T.CRT_DT , T.MDFY_DT , T.CRTR_ID , T.MDFYR_ID , T.DEL_YN , T.CORRECT_ANSWER , T.SUB_QUESTION FROM TESTS T WHERE T.ID = #{_parameter} AND T.DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT TS.ID AS SET_ID , TS.COURSE_ID , TS.TEST_TYPE , TS.SET_NAME , TS.SHOW_YN , T.ID AS TEST_ID , T.SUBJECT_ID , T.QUESTION , T.ANSWER_TYPE , T.ANSWER_SHEET_1 , T.ANSWER_SHEET_2 , T.ANSWER_SHEET_3 , T.ANSWER_SHEET_4 , T.ANSWER_SHEET_5 , T.ANSWER_COUNT , T.POINT_ALLOC , T.CRT_DT , T.MDFY_DT , T.CRTR_ID , T.MDFYR_ID , T.CORRECT_ANSWER , T.SUB_QUESTION FROM TEST_SET TS INNER JOIN TEST_SET_TESTS TST ON TS.ID = TST.TEST_SET_ID INNER JOIN TESTS T ON TST.TEST_ID = T.ID WHERE T.DEL_YN = 'N' AND TS.COURSE_ID = #{courseId} ORDER BY TS.ID DESC
mapper.insert:
SELECT ('TT-' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD-') || LPAD(SEQ_TESTS_PK.NEXTVAL, 6, '0')) FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TESTS (ID , SUBJECT_ID , QUESTION , ANSWER_TYPE , ANSWER_SHEET_1 , ANSWER_SHEET_2 , ANSWER_SHEET_3 , ANSWER_SHEET_4 , ANSWER_SHEET_5 , ANSWER_COUNT , POINT_ALLOC , CRT_DT , MDFY_DT , CRTR_ID , MDFYR_ID , DEL_YN , CORRECT_ANSWER , SUB_QUESTION) VALUES ( #{id} , #{subjectId} , #{question} , #{answerType} , #{answerSheet1} , #{answerSheet2} , #{answerSheet3} , #{answerSheet4} , #{answerSheet5} , #{answerCount} , #{pointAlloc} , SYSDATE , SYSDATE , 'admin' , 'admin' , 'N' , #{correctAnswer} , #{subQuestion} )
mapper.delete: UPDATE TESTS SET DEL_YN = 'Y' , MDFY_DT = SYSDATE WHERE ID = #{_parameter} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.insert:
SELECT ('TS-' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD-') || LPAD(SEQ_TESTS_PK.NEXTVAL, 6, '0')) FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TEST_SET (ID , COURSE_ID , TEST_TYPE , SET_NAME , SHOW_YN) VALUES ( #{RegistTestSetVO.id} , #{courseId} , #{RegistTestSetVO.testType} , #{RegistTestSetVO.setName} , #{RegistTestSetVO.showYn})

SELECT ('TE-' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD-') || LPAD(SEQ_TESTS_PK.NEXTVAL, 6, '0')) FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TEST_SET_TESTS ( ID , TEST_SET_ID , TEST_ID) VALUES (#{id} ,#{testSetId} ,#{questionId})
mapper.select: SELECT ID , COURSE_ID , TEST_TYPE , SET_NAME , SHOW_YN FROM TEST_SET WHERE ID = #{parameter}

SELECT T.ID , T.SUBJECT_ID , T.QUESTION , T.ANSWER_TYPE , T.ANSWER_SHEET_1 , T.ANSWER_SHEET_2 , T.ANSWER_SHEET_3 , T.ANSWER_SHEET_4 , T.ANSWER_SHEET_5 , T.ANSWER_COUNT , T.POINT_ALLOC , T.CRT_DT , T.MDFY_DT , T.CRTR_ID , T.MDFYR_ID , T.DEL_YN , T.CORRECT_ANSWER , T.SUB_QUESTION FROM TESTS T WHERE DEL_YN = 'N' AND T.ID IN (SELECT TST.TEST_ID FROM TEST_SET_TESTS TST WHERE TST.TEST_SET_ID = #{parameter}) ORDER BY T.ID
SELECT T.ID , T.ANSWER_TYPE , T.CORRECT_ANSWER FROM TEST_SET_TESTS TST INNER JOIN TESTS T ON T.ID = TST.TEST_ID WHERE TST.TEST_SET_ID = #{_parameter} AND T.DEL_YN = 'N'
